flow cytometry assay (2) vs flow cytomet.reply: DIFFERENT: Record A measures intracellular cytokine-producing activated CD4 T-cell responses (CD154, IL-2, IFN-γ) after peptide stimulation, whereas Record B measures memory/Th-phenotype surface-marker subsets of CD4 T cells (CD45RA, CCR7, CCR4, CXCR3, CCR6, CD154).

flow cytometry assay (3) vs flow cytomet.reply: DIFFERENT: the specimens differ (PBMCs after peptide stimulation versus purified autologous CD4+ T cells co-cultured with dendritic cells) and the intracellular marker/readout panels differ (IFN-γ/IL-2/CD154 versus IFN-γ/IL-5/IL-13/CD154).
